parameters.content:
## Webhook contract

pipeline/generateContent.py POSTs here after a render finishes:

```
{ story_number, story_file_name,
  video_path, metadata_path,
  duration_seconds, render_seconds }
```

Configured as N8N_RENDER_WEBHOOK in .env.

Story Paths falls back to building the paths from story_number, so a
hand-fired {"story_number": 36} still publishes.

**This workflow must be ACTIVE** or the production webhook is not registered.

## Upload quota is the real ceiling

videos.insert costs 1,600 units against a 10,000/day default: about **6 uploads per day**, so most runs 403 on quota. Both HTTP nodes route errors to Classify Failure.

**Per-platform pausing.** A limit error creates HorrorStories/blocked_<platform>.flag; Platform Status reads the flags at the start of every run and each lane's *Blocked?* gate skips it for 24 h. Stop Pipeline runs only when all three flags are fresh (All Blocked?). start-pipeline.ps1 clears the flags.

parameters.content:
## Instagram branch
Runs beside the YouTube branch, not after it. Needs the `Instagram Graph` query-auth credential (access_token) on the four HTTP nodes, and VIDEO_PUBLIC_BASE / VIDEO_URL_SECRET / IG_USER_ID in .env so `$env` resolves them.

Meta downloads the mp4 from videoUrl (served by pipeline/videoServer.py through the tunnel), so the container takes 20-60 s to reach FINISHED. IG Ready? loops through IG Wait up to 15 times, then gives up. A limit error (codes 4/9/17/32/613) pauses Instagram for 24 h via blocked_instagram.flag; Stop Pipeline only fires once all three platforms are paused.

parameters.content:
## TikTok branch
Direct Post via the Content Posting API, bytes pushed from n8n (FILE_UPLOAD, one chunk; renders are 30-40 MB, the cap is 64 MB). Needs TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY / TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET / TIKTOK_TOKEN_FILE / TIKTOK_PRIVACY_LEVEL in .env.

Access tokens last 24 h, so every run refreshes from the refresh token stored in TIKTOK_TOKEN_FILE and writes the rotated pair back. Until the app passes the Direct Post audit TikTok only allows SELF_ONLY (private) posts; TT Params falls back to SELF_ONLY whenever creator_info does not offer the requested level. A limit error (spam_risk_too_many_posts, rate_limit_exceeded, ...) pauses TikTok for 24 h via blocked_tiktok.flag; Stop Pipeline only fires once all three platforms are paused.

parameters.subject: =Pipeline STOPPED - YouTube, Instagram and TikTok are all blocked
parameters.message:
={{ 'All three platforms hit their posting limits within the last 24 h, so the whole pipeline (watcher, cloudflared, video server, n8n, LM Studio) is being stopped to avoid generating stories that cannot be posted.

Videos and metadata stay on disk. Restart with:
  .\scripts\start-pipeline.ps1

The launcher clears HorrorStories/blocked_*.flag, and each flag expires on its own after 24 h. Re-publish missed stories by POSTing story_number to /webhook/render-complete.' }}
